A literal line ending inside a code span folds to a space, per CommonMark

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>see <code>a\nb</code> here</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
